comment: Default input bindings, registered at startup; every action is rebindable in Settings > Controls (saved to user://keybinds.cfg over these). Terraria habits: left click uses, right click interacts, 1-0 and the mouse wheel (down: next slot) pick the hotbar slot, Q throws the held item, M opens the map, Enter shows the chat history, Tab/I the inventory, which you can walk, jump, grapple and fight with open. Kept for a 3D game: E interacts, F grapples (Terraria's E), Ctrl drops through platforms (Terraria's S), Shift sprints. X toggles Smart Cursor. Quick heal/mana/buff come later (P3-33). Bindings are key:<name>, mouse:<1-9>, pad:<a|b|x|y|back|start|ls|rs|lb|rb|dpad_up|dpad_down|dpad_left|dpad_right|…> or axis:<left_x|left_y|right_x|right_y|lt|rt><+|->; keyboard/mouse and controller rebind separately. Controller (Xbox names, X-04): left stick moves, right stick looks (gentle aim assist), A jumps, B drops through platforms, X interacts, Y opens the inventory, RT uses the item, LT grapples, LB/RB step the hotbar, LS sprints, RS toggles Smart Cursor, D-pad up mounts, down throws the item, left cycles the block shape, right swaps first/third person, View opens the map and Menu pauses. On a screen the D-pad or left stick moves the cursor, A clicks, X takes one (right click, hold to repeat), RB quick-moves (Shift-click), LB marks a favourite and B closes; the ui_* actions are only read while a screen has the controller.
